subject: Open Revolution R supports R Shiny

messages.author: 9349b31ec7c243b2
messages.subject: Open Revolution R supports R Shiny
parts:
Is this true? How would I use ORR instead of standard R in a hosted Shiny application?
Thanks,
D

messages.author: ec79ef2df02af517
messages.subject: Re: Open Revolution R supports R Shiny
parts:
"Revolution R Open can work side-by-side with any other version of R. During installation, a symbolic link is created under /usr/bin/ that points to the last version of R that was installed, in this case Revolution R Open. In order to continue working with a different version of R than the last installed from a terminal window, you must specify the full path to the R executable you want to use."

http://mran.revolutionanalytics.com/documents/rro/installation/#tab-W1RE08s2H-0

I presume this means that Shiny will also just use the latest version of R that was installed on the hosting server, as per the symbolic link under /usr/bin.

I don't know is this would be at all possible for an app hosted by shinyapps.io, but I can't see how it would be unless those guys has installed ORR (which is a question to ask in this group I suppose: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shinyapps-users)
